name: More sound options
author: RussoDaFederal
description:
This plugin implements more sound options, including audio panning! Now you can handle multiple background songs at once (if you want to cross fade two songs as you cross a given map area for example) and more!

WARNING! To enable this plugin, you must first update the file howler.js (v2.2.1) located in your game folder:
resources/app/Content/Datas/Scripts/Libs/howler.js

Tested with current version of howler.js (v2.2.4), available at
https://github.com/goldfire/howler.js/blob/master/dist/howler.js

commands.name: Load track
commands.description: Load a sound file into the memory (doesn't automatically play it)

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: This ID must be unique and will be used for other sound commands. Similar to how pictures work.

commands.name: Remove track
commands.description: Unload a track from the list

commands.name: Play
commands.description: Play an audio on the list

commands.name: Pause
commands.description: Pause an audio on the list

commands.name: Seek
commands.description: Skip an audio on the list to a given time

commands.name: Fade
commands.description: Gradually increase/decrease the volume of an audio on the list

defaultParameters.name: duration
defaultParameters.description: Duration (in seconds) of the fade effect

commands.name: Loop
commands.description: Set whether an audio on the list should loop or not

commands.name: Set volume
commands.description: Set the volume of an audio on the list

commands.name: Set speed
commands.description: Set the speed of an audio on the list

commands.name: Set pan
commands.description: Set the pan of an audio on the list

defaultParameters.name: value
defaultParameters.description: -1 means the audio will play on the left ear only. 0 is equal. 1 is right ear

commands.name: Anchor
commands.description: Anchor a sound to a map object. Its volume will fade when the hero moves away from the source and its pan will be controlled automatically.

defaultParameters.name: objID
defaultParameters.description: ID of the map object. -1 is self, 0 is hero.

defaultParameters.name: minDist
defaultParameters.description: Value for minimum distance in squares. If the hero is closer than this, volume will be 100 and pan will be 0

defaultParameters.name: maxDist
defaultParameters.description: Value for maximum distance in squares. If the hero is further than this, volume will be 0

defaultParameters.name: stereo
defaultParameters.description: Whether pan is affected by distance or not. This means if the sound is coming from the left, the player will hear it mostly from the left speaker.

defaultParameters.name: wallBlock
defaultParameters.description: Percentage (0-100) of volume that is lost when there's a wall (only walls and mountains count) between the hero and the audio source. If the percentage is 20 and there are 5 or more walls on the way, the volume is set to 0. If the percentage is 0, walls don't affect the volume at all.

defaultParameters.name: expFade
defaultParameters.description: Sets the formula for volume loss to be exponential instead of linear. ON = exponential, OFF = linear.

commands.name: Free
commands.description: The opposite of Anchor. Frees the audio track from its anchor, reverting it to a regular audio, not constrained by the distance to the hero.
